items.title: Buzzy Williams Interview, 1980-06-18
items.q: So I thought it was one of his, Alice, his Jenny on the doors and all that, the cribs and stuff, see.

ctx.x: I was born a scared kid. My older sister used to pick up with a buggy, a boogeyman. I was so frightened I'd go to school. This is a true story. Byers watched two and two. Bingo. It's gone, see. I really went to the fifth grade. And I got so damn nervous. I told my father I want to go to work. Well, around 1919, they had avatars working at the 112th Street in Amsterdam, Avenue across the street from St. John's Cathedral. It's the second largest in the world. And all it had was one arch.
